title: Instagram Caption Counter
description: Write Instagram captions with live stats — characters vs the 2,200 limit, hashtags, mentions and the 125-char fold preview.
howto: Watch characters, hashtags (#) and mentions (@) counted live.
Check the fold preview: only ~125 characters show before "… more".

faqs.q: How long can an Instagram caption be?
faqs.a: 2,200 characters. Only the first ~125 show in the feed before the "more" cutoff, so front-load the hook.

faqs.q: How many hashtags can I use?
faqs.a: Up to 30 per post. This tool counts them live; 3–8 relevant hashtags usually outperform 30 generic ones.

faqs.q: Does the counter include line breaks?
faqs.a: Yes — every character including line breaks and emoji counts toward the 2,200 limit.
